item.title: 'I am fearless': New York Attorney General indicted months after defeating Trump in court— Who is Letitia James?
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James, facing bank fraud charges she calls "baseless," asserts her "fearless" stance, linking the indictment to President Trump's alleged "weaponization" of the justice system. She highlights her successful lawsuit against Trump's company and criticizes the replacement of a US Attorney who didn't indict her. James vows to fight the charges aggressively.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Historic moment’: Palestinian President hails Gaza deal in rare interview to Israeli channel; hopes ‘it remains this way’
item.description: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas described the new Gaza ceasefire as a "historic moment," expressing hope for lasting peace and an end to regional bloodshed. He stated that the Palestinian Authority has initiated reforms in various sectors, including a revised payment system for prisoners' families, as part of a plan linked to Gaza's reconstruction and Palestinian statehood.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Another Trump foe prosecuted: NY AG Letitia James indicted by justice department; she says ‘desperate weaponisation of system’
item.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James faces federal bank fraud charges in Virginia, stemming from a 2023 mortgage. Prosecutors allege she misrepresented a property as her primary residence. James, a vocal Trump critic, decried the indictment as politically motivated, a move occurring shortly after charges against former FBI Director James Comey. Legal experts express concern over potential justice department politicization.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “As the son of an undocumented immigrant:” Serena Williams’ husband Alexis Ohanian reveals his mother could have been deported as ICE raids tear families apart
item.description: Alexis Ohanian, husband of Serena Williams, spoke out against recent ICE arrests, sharing his personal connection as the son of an undocumented immigrant. He emphasized the importance of "smart borders and humane immigration reform" that includes a fair legalization plan, rather than breaking up families.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

‘Awaits the peace President’: Israel invites Donald Trump to address parliament; calls him ‘greatest friend’
item.description: Israeli Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana has invited former US President Donald Trump to address the parliament, calling him the "greatest friend and ally of the Jewish people." The invitation highlights Trump's role in brokering regional agreements and recognizing Jerusalem as Israel's capital. This marks a significant gesture of gratitude for his leadership and the US-Israel alliance.

item.title: Tragic road accident in Oman kills 8 Bangladeshi workers, driver critically injured
item.description: Eight Bangladeshi workers from the Chattogram region died in a tragic road accident near Duqm, Oman, when their microbus collided with a fishing container truck. The driver was critically injured and hospitalized. The Bangladesh Social Club confirmed the victims’ identities, and the embassy is handling repatriation. Authorities have detained a man for filming the accident scene, with legal action ongoing.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Need very badly’: Donald Trump announces Arctic cutters deal with Finland; US to buy 11 Icebreakers
item.description: America is set to acquire 11 icebreaking vessels from Finland, a significant move to boost its Arctic presence. President Trump announced the deal, emphasizing Finland's expertise in building these crucial ships. This collaboration will see four vessels constructed in Finland and seven in the US, strengthening bilateral defense ties amidst rising Arctic importance.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: Drone plot foiled: Belgian PM Bart De Wever targeted in a jihadist-Iispired attack; 3 arrested
item.description: Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever was the target of a foiled jihadist-inspired plot involving drone-mounted explosives aimed at attacking politicians. Federal prosecutors announced the arrest of three suspects in connection with the case, which authorities say involved plans to use explosive-rigged drones against political figures. The swift action of security services and the judiciary averted a potentially devastating attack.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Hasan Piker collargate: Twitch Streamer denies shock collar use after dog's viral yelp. Netizens ain’t buying it
item.description: Popular streamer Hasan Piker faces animal cruelty accusations after a clip showed his dog yelping. Piker claims it was an accident and his dog wears a vibration-only collar. Critics, however, point to past comments and a blinking light on the device, sparking outrage and calls for investigation. PETA also weighed in, condemning shock collars.

item.title: ‘From can’t shutdown to shutdown’: Donald Trump blasts Chuck Schumer over 'every day gets better' remark - GOP rallies behind
item.description: President Trump criticized Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer's optimistic remarks about Democratic progress during the ongoing government shutdown. Trump asserted that the situation is worsening for Democrats, accusing Schumer of shutting down the government for partisan gain. Schumer had stated that Democrats' position on healthcare and ending the shutdown was strengthening daily.
